Alana (People Ops): Heads up  Auditors requested we move to a staggered upload schedule for the SOC2/ISO evidence next month to spread reviewer work. Please confirm your team's evidence owner in the Confluence table by EOD tomorrow: https://confluence.redwood.ai/compliance/2026-audit-window
Jordan (Security): Clarifying Q: does this change what we collect or only when we hand it over?
Alana (People Ops): Only timing. Checklist stays the same. This just prevents one massive upload day and gives reviewers time for deeper checks.
Ravi (Eng): Can you share lane assignments here so small teams can coordinate?
Alana (People Ops): Lane map: A (week 2026-05-04): Runtime & Serving; B (week 2026-05-11): Platform Infra, SRE, Observability; C (week 2026-05-18): SDKs, DevEx, Docs; D (week 2026-05-25): GTM (sales/support) controls-only.
Lisa (Legal): Reminder: redact PII per the redaction checklist before upload. Legal will do spot checks.
Ravi (Eng): Evidence owner: Ravi K. I'll upload runbooks, access lists, and the incident playbook by Friday. Preferred formats?
Alana (People Ops): PDFs for policies, CSV manifest for inventories. Large logs can be zipped under 500MB per chunk with README and SHA256. Use tag format evidence_2026_<lane>_<team>.
Jordan (Security): We'll provide a KV/secret handling checklist to add to the manifest. Security will review Lanes A/B.
compliance-bot: Reminder set for 2026-04-28 09:00 UTC: "Confirm evidence owner in Confluence"
Alana (People Ops): We'll host a 30-min office hours on 2026-04-29 16:00 UTC for upload questions; recording will be posted. Thanks! :thumbsup:
